v: Understand the parts of a website
Plan what your site is for
Domain - the address people type, like yourshop.com
Hosting - a computer on the internet that stores your site and shows it to visitors
Website software - a free content management system (CMS) that lets you add pages without code
Content - your text, photos, prices and contact details

b.v: Social media pages are rented space: the rules and reach can change any day. A website is yours. It shows up on search, looks professional on a visiting card, and works for you all day.

v: Domain: a yearly fee
Hosting: a monthly or yearly fee; small business plans are low-cost
Website software and many themes: free
Your time: a weekend for a simple site

b.v: No budget yet? An XpertCreation Store shop on a free subdomain is a good first step, and you can move to your own domain later.
Do this now:|Write in one line what your site is for: sell, show services, or share information.|List 5 things a visitor must find on it.

v: Pick a good name
Register it safely in your own name
Short and easy to spell when you say it on the phone
Your business name or what you do: ahmedtailors.com
Without hyphens and numbers if possible
.com for everyone, .pk for a Pakistan audience

b.v: Step by step:|Search the name at a domain registrar.|Compare the first-year price and the renewal price - renewal is often higher.|Register it with your own name and email, not your web designer's.|Turn on auto-renew so you never lose it.
If someone else registers the domain for you, make sure the account is in your name. Many businesses lost their domain because only the designer had the login.
Do this now:|Write 5 name ideas.|Check which are free.|Pick one and note its yearly renewal price.

v: Understand hosting plans
Choose one that fits a small business
Shared hosting - many sites on one server; cheap and fine for most small sites
Managed hosting for website builders - easier, a bit more expensive
Your own server (VPS) - powerful, but you must manage it yourself
Free SSL certificate - the lock icon and https
Daily or weekly backups
A one-click installer for the website software
Support that answers quickly, ideally in your language
Enough storage for your photos

b.v: Your host gives you two 'nameserver' addresses. Paste them in your domain settings at the registrar. It can take a few hours before the domain opens your hosting.
Do this now:|Compare 3 hosting plans for price, SSL, backups and support.|Write which one you would pick and why.

v: Install the free website builder
Log in to your dashboard safely

b.v: Step by step:|Log in to your hosting control panel.|Find the app installer and choose the website builder (CMS).|Pick your domain and choose https.|Set the site title, an admin username (not 'admin') and a strong password.|Click install and wait a minute.

v: Pages - Home, About, Contact
Posts - news or blog articles
Appearance - themes and menus
Plugins - add-ons for forms, maps, shops
Settings - site name, time zone, language

b.v: Save your admin login in a password manager or a safe notebook. Never share it on chat.
Do this now:|Install the website software on a test domain or a free trial.|Log in and open each menu once.

v: Choose a clean, fast theme
Set your logo, colours and fonts
Light and fast - avoid themes full of moving effects
Looks good on a phone - most visitors come from mobiles
Updated recently and well reviewed
Supports right-to-left text if you will write in Urdu
Logo at the top left (top right for Urdu)
Two main colours, used everywhere
One easy-to-read font for text
Plenty of white space

b.v: Keep the menu short: Home, About, Services or Products, Contact. Five or six items at most.
Do this now:|Install a free theme.|Upload your logo and set two colours.|Open the site on your phone and check it looks right.

v: Create the main pages
Know what goes on each one
One sentence: what you do and for whom
A clear button: Call now, Order, or Get a quote
3 main services or best products
Real photos and honest reviews from customers
About - your story, team and experience
Services or Products - each with price or 'from' price
Contact - phone, email, address, map, working hours
Privacy policy - what you do with visitors' data

b.v: Visitors scan, they don't read. Use short headings, short paragraphs and points. Answer their questions: price, time, location, how to order.
Do this now:|Create the 5 pages.|Write the one-sentence headline for your home page.

v: Write clear content
Add photos that load fast
One idea per paragraph
Use the words your customers use when they search
Check spelling; ask a friend to read it
Put your phone number where people can tap to call
Use your own photos or free stock photos with a licence that allows business use
Make them smaller before upload: about 1600 pixels wide is enough
Compress them so each is under 300 KB
Add 'alt text' - a short description for search engines and blind visitors

b.v: Do not copy pictures or text from other websites. It can bring legal trouble and hurts your search ranking.
Do this now:|Resize and compress 3 photos.|Add them to your Home page with alt text.

day-8.t: Day 8 — Contact forms, maps and calls

v: Make it easy to contact you
Keep spam out

b.v: Step by step:|Install a contact form plugin.|Ask only what you need: name, phone, message.|Send the form to your email and test it.|Turn on spam protection (a simple check box or puzzle).
Add a map of your location from a free map service, with your full address below it. It helps people find you and builds trust.

v: Make your phone number a tap-to-call link
Add a chat button that opens your business chat
Show working hours so people know when you reply

b.v: Do this now:|Add a form, a map and a tap-to-call number to your Contact page.|Send yourself a test message.

v: Help search engines understand your site
Get listed as a local business
A clear title with your service and city: 'Tailor in Lahore - Ahmed Tailors'
A one-line description under 160 characters
One main heading per page
Fast loading - small photos, few plugins

b.v: 2) Tell search engines about your site
Step by step:|Turn on the sitemap in your search plugin.|Add your site to the free webmaster tools of the main search engines.|Submit the sitemap link there.
Create a free business listing on the main map services with the same name, address and phone as your site. Ask real customers for reviews.
Do this now:|Write titles and descriptions for your 5 pages.|Submit your sitemap.

v: Keep your site safe
Launch with a checklist
Update the website software, theme and plugins every month
Use few plugins, only well-known ones; delete the ones you don't use
Strong admin password and two-step login
Never install 'free' copies of paid themes - they often contain malware

b.v: Turn on automatic backups at your host or with a backup plugin, and keep one copy outside the hosting (for example on your computer). Test once that you can restore it.

v: Every page opens on phone and computer
Forms reach your email
https lock shows on every page
Phone, address and hours are correct
Share the link on XpertConnect and your visiting card

b.v: Take the quiz to get your certificate, then launch your site and update it at least once a month.
Do this now:|Go through the launch checklist.|Set a monthly reminder for updates and backups.
